name: finanzen-news-research
title_zh: 德媒头条扫完直接落进本地持仓档案
tagline_zh: 每天开盘前扫 finanzen.net 头条，自动带链接和出处生成德文简报。
tagline_en: Morning scan of finanzen.net headlines, auto-built into a sourced German briefing, then saved to Portfolio.
desc_en: Read current finanzen.net news, create a sourced German market-news report, and publish it to the local Portfolio Analyser through MCP. Use for finanzen.net news scans and news reports; do not use for portfolio recommendations or broad investment-opportunity screens.
why_zh: 它把「读新闻」和「记档案」焊成一条流水线：来源、时间、链接全自动归档。
why_en: It welds news-reading and record-keeping into one flow: sources, timestamps, links auto-archived, cutting the repetitive hop.
limit_zh: 只认 finanzen.net 的德文页面；只产出新闻摘要和来源清单，不做投资建议、不筛机会、不翻译成中文。
limit_en: Only reads German pages on finanzen.net; outputs summaries with sources only — no advice, no screening, no translation. Stops outside that scope.
title_en: German market news scan, filed straight into your local.
